text:
kevin: Quick heads-up, deploying release/2026.03.20. session_affinity_v2 flag will be enabled in 3 waves: 5% -> 25% -> 60% over 90m. We'll pin existing sessions to old behavior for 30m after each step. Rolling window starts 11:05 UTC. /cc @ops-oncall :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started for release/2026.03.20 on cluster-us-west-2. tracking id db-1739999999. Steps: preflight -> canary -> ramp.

priya: Can we get telemetry panels ready? I want per-route latency, error-rate, and token-cost. Also sample outputs for prompt groups A/B.

sarah: Rollback criteria: >3% error increase sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 600ms over baseline by +200ms. If hit, immediate disable and roll back to session_affinity_v1. Document in ticket INF-2486.

ops-oncall: Oncall here. Runbook pinned. I'll watch infra metrics + capacity. If KV cache miss spike, we'll pause and pin cohorts. :eyes: 

marta: Note: enabling session_affinity_v2 requires cache key bump. We'll warm caches before canary. Also added a short TTL to avoid long-term drift.

kevin: warming caches now: running script:
```
./scripts/warm_kv.sh --prefix session_aff_v2 --routes '/chat,/stream'
```
ETA 6m.

deploy-bot: Canary finished. 5% traffic healthy. Metrics: error_delta 0.1%, p95 +10ms. Proceeding to 25% in 10m.

priya: Starting synthetic prompt set run on canary. Posting link to results in INF-2486.

sarah: Reminder: if output-quality regression >2% on evals for any prompt group, we stop the ramp. Quality alerts wired to PagerDuty.

ops-oncall: Observed small KV miss spike during warm. Cleared, no user impact.

kevin: moving to 25% now. Pinning active sessions for 30m after shift. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Ramp to 25% complete. Monitoring for 20m.

marta: After 20m, if stable, we'll prepare for 60% step. I'll also enqueue a cache drain for old keys 40m after full ramp.

priya: All synthetic checks green so far.

sarah: All gates pass. Proceed to 60% in 15m unless anyone objects.

ops-oncall: No objections. I'll keep a close eye on capacity delta.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 60% initiated.

kevin: 60% live. Updating release note: "session_affinity_v2: sticky session routing with per-user pinning; gradual rollout, no expected user-visible changes." Adding rollback notes.

priya: Post-mortem checklist link: /docs/release-checklist.md - remember to update telemetry dashboards with the new tag session_aff_v2.

sarah: All good. If no issues in 2h, we'll promote config to default and start auto-scaling policy change tomorrow. Thanks team :tada:
